name: CHAIN Practice Simulator [CHOKE]
desc:
The first half of update is here! I hope y'all enjoy it!

CHAIN Practice Simulator is a game where you can practice freely the QTEs from an another Roblox Game titled of CHAIN, to get yourself better at the game and practice more.

This game is on early access, which it means that everything may be subject to change, or even more things will be added, i made the QTEs as more accurate as possible to the game, and the dificulty it heavily depends on your FPS, so good luck, and practice.

Supported Devices:
- PC
- Mobile
- Xbox/Playstation

All credits goes to Yurixzaaa and her Team Development.
